title: Harness agent-brief-guard: 3-skill-ref + SPEC requirement
desc: Blocks an Agent/Agent.cmd dispatch whose brief lacks 3 executed skill-read refs or the 5-part SPEC (Goal/Files/Approach/Constraints/Exit). Subagents start blank; the brief is their only knowledge.
steps: TRIGGER: an Agent or Agent.cmd dispatch is blocked when the prompt has fewer than 3 'wkappbot skill read <id>' lines, or is missing any of the labeled SPEC sections Goal, Files, Approach, Constraints, Exit.

FIX: add agent-on-load plus 2 task-specific skill reads at the top, then the 5 SPEC labels. Do NOT abandon delegation and do the work yourself -- that is a harness violation. Re-dispatch with the fixed brief.

WHY: a blank-start subagent inherits zero context; under-briefed agents exit early or do the wrong thing, wasting more tokens than a complete brief. See: agent-on-load, claude-code-agent-tier-routing, agent-dispatch-preflight.
author: claude
